title: Cross-functional initiative mapping playbook and roadmap guardrails
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a practical, operational playbook and set of roadmap guardrails that align company-level OKRs with cross-functional initiatives. The goal is to reduce single-threaded ownership ambiguity, speed decision-making at milestone boundaries, and make trade-offs explicit for engineering, design, and GTM. The deliverables are: 1) a one-page playbook for initiative owners, 2) a mapping template for OKR -> initiative -> milestones, 3) escalation & decision rules, and 4) a lightweight tracking sheet for executive syncs.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook PDF + Confluence page published and linked from Console team page
Mapping template (Google Sheet) populated for all company OKRs with initiative owners assigned
Escalation rules documented with RACI and two-week SLA for cross-functional disagreements
Pilot run through for two initiatives (one infra/runtime, one console/UX) with feedback incorporated
Stakeholder sign-off from Eng, Design, Revenue, and CEO represented in a Confluence approval comment
decisions: Adopt single canonical mapping: OKR -> Initiative -> Epic -> Milestone; owners must update weekly
Use two-tier escalation: first to initiative leads (48h), then to cross-functional council (7d) for unresolved disputes
Guardrail: Initiatives may request deviation from OKR target only with explicit quantified trade-offs (cost, latency, scope) and approval from PM lead
Tracking cadence: executive 15m weekly sync + monthly deep dive on cross-org dependencies
tradeoffs_and_risks: Tight guardrails speed decisions but may stifle local iteration; mitigated by preserving a 10% 'local-experiment' budget per initiative
Centralized escalation reduces skew but adds process overhead for small conflicts; will monitor frequency during pilot
Mapping overhead could be heavy for fast-moving teams — template will provide automation hooks to pull GH labels and Console dashboard links
next_steps: Draft Confluence playbook and share with Eng/design leads for feedback (owner: Miguel) by 2025-02-21
Create Google Sheet mapping template and import current OKRs (owner: Asha) by 2025-02-25
